data: Amazon's operating income rose from $36,852 million in fiscal 2023 to $79,975 million in fiscal 2025, according to the Consolidated Statements of Operations in its fiscal 2025 Form 10-K. That is an increase of $43,123 million, or about 117.0%, so operating income more than doubled over the two years. Fiscal 2024 sat in between at $68,593 million. Over the same period, total net sales grew from $574,785 million to $716,924 million, about 24.7%. Operating income therefore grew much faster than revenue, and operating margin widened from roughly 6.4% in fiscal 2023 to about 11.2% in fiscal 2025.
